tasks.label: 🛠️ 1. 编译 AT32 固件
tasks.command: rm -rf build_at32 && cmake -B build_at32 -DBUILD_SIMULATOR=OFF ; cmake --build build_at32 -j4

tasks.label: 🛠️ 2. 编译 Linux 仿真
tasks.command: rm -rf build_sim && cmake -B build_sim -DBUILD_SIMULATOR=ON ; cmake --build build_sim -j4

tasks.label: ⚡ 3. 烧录固件到单片机 (ST-Link V2)
tasks.command: openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -f ./AT32F403AVGT7PHC/at32f403a.cfg -c 'init; halt; mww 0xE000EDFC 0x01000001; mww 0xE000ED0C 0x05FA0004; sleep 50; halt; flash write_image erase build_at32/test.elf.elf; verify_image build_at32/test.elf.elf; mww 0xE000ED0C 0x05FA0004; exit'
